text:
tori: hi team, first morning at Redwood! followed onboarding steps but can't reach internal ticketing (tickets.internal.redwood). browser times out, curl 10.60.2.11:443 -> Connection refused. i'm on macbook pro, using 'redwood-split' profile on home ISP.

it-support: welcome! quick checks: did you install our root cert bundle and the auth cert? also which VPN client version?

tori: certs done, client 1.4.3 via homebrew. wg shows endpoint 34.120.10.2:51820 and allowed ips 0.0.0.0/0. utun0 ip 100.96.8.45.

neteng: that IP range 100.96.8.0/24 is our temporary onboarding pool. we recently enabled stricter ALB Source CIDR checks — might be blocked. can you traceroute to 10.60.2.11 and paste first 6 hops?

tori: traceroute: 1 192.168.1.1, 2 10.0.0.1, 3 34.120.10.2, 4 * *, 5 * * 6 * *

james: @neteng fyi we flipped the ALB sticky IP policy yesterday; it only accepts 10.60.0.0/16 and peered-vpc ranges. onboarding pool should be translated but maybe the NAT rule missed this /24.

ops-bot: created NETWORK-4733 for onboarding NAT mismatch (assignee: neteng).

neteng: confirmed — the NAT gateway translation table missed 100.96.8.0/24 after the last rollout. adding translation rule now; give it ~2 minutes.

infra-bot: infra-deploy: NAT-translation update applied to prod-peering (deploy id nat-2026-11).

neteng: try curl again now.

tori: curl works! can load tickets UI. thank you. quick follow-up: ssh to bastion still fails with "kex_exchange_identification: Connection closed by remote host".

it-support: do you see any Okta prompts? sometimes the SSO plugin 0.9.1 fails with older OpenSSH. run `ssh -V` and `brew list okta-ssh`

tori: ssh -V -> OpenSSH_8.9p1, okta-ssh listed. but ssh hangs after authenticating.

james: we had a bug with the bastion's webhook that rejects connections from split-tunnel clients unless they present the corporate TLS SNI. try forcing SNI via `ssh -o ProxyCommand="openssl s_client -connect bastion.redwood:443 -servername bastion.redwood -quiet | nc localhost 22"` — (this is a temporary debug command).

tori: using ProxyCommand worked and i got a shell through the jump. what should i do for normal ssh?

neteng: we'll add your utun IP 100.96.8.45 to the bastion allowlist for 12h and fix the SNI requirement for onboarding pool. leaving NETWORK-4733 open until we confirm.

ops-bot: NETWORK-4733 updated: temporary bastion allow added; monitoring 30m.

people-ops: confirmed tori's start/HR onboarding processed; scheduling device enrollment later today.

tori: huge thanks! saved my entire afternoon. is there a recommended local setting (split vs full) while getting set up?

it-support: keep split for perf, but switch to full when doing heavy infra work or debugging; otherwise use the bastion/proxy. we'll add a note to the onboarding doc.

tori: closing this. :wave:
